description.raw: '''Innate - Pyromania:''' '''Annie''' generates a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''[[File:Annie Disintegrate.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie#Disintegrate|An icon for Annie's ability Disintegrate]] [[Annie#Disintegrate|Disintegrate]]'' or casts her other [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]], stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains ''Energized''.
description.text: Innate - Pyromania: Annie generates a stack of Pyromania whenever she hits an enemy with Disintegrate or casts her other abilities, stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains Energized.

description2.raw: '''Energized:''' '''Annie''' empowers her next cast of ''[[File:Annie Disintegrate.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie#Disintegrate|An icon for Annie's ability Disintegrate]] [[Annie#Disintegrate|Disintegrate]]'', ''[[File:Annie Incinerate.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie#Incinerate|An icon for Annie's ability Incinerate]] [[Annie#Incinerate|Incinerate]]'', or ''[[File:Annie Summon- Tibbers.png|20xpx|border|link=Annie#Summon: Tibbers|An icon for Annie's ability Summon: Tibbers]] [[Annie#Summon: Tibbers|Summon: Tibbers]]'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] enemies hit for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 (based on level) seconds.
description2.text: Energized: Annie empowers her next cast of Disintegrate, Incinerate, or Summon: Tibbers to consume all Pyromania stacks to stun enemies hit for 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 (based on level) seconds.

description3.raw: '''Annie''' gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]].
description3.text: Annie gains maximum stacks of Pyromania when the game starts and upon respawning. She will lose Energized and all Pyromania stacks upon death.

notes.raw: * '''Annie''' does not lose any stacks upon entering or exiting [[File:Revival icon.png|20px|link=Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|An icon representing the keyword Resurrection]] [[:Death#Ways to prevent death when reaching zero health|resurrection]]. * Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * ''Pyromania's'' current stacks are represented by a counter under '''Annie's''' [[health bar]], visible to all players. It lights up when the empowered effect is available.
notes.text:
Annie does not lose any stacks upon entering or exiting resurrection.
Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by spell shield.
Pyromania's current stacks are represented by a counter under Annie's health bar, visible to all players. It lights up when the empowered effect is available.
